q: What carbon data do car makers ask Durban auto suppliers for?
title: Durban auto suppliers: carbon data
short: Expect Scope 1 and 2 totals with the Eskom grid factor, a figure per part and a reduction plan, often for exports to Europe. Eskom power is coal heavy, so electricity is usually the largest share of a supplier footprint, and rooftop solar or wheeled renewable power lowers it fastest.
audience: Component suppliers in Durban, Pinetown and Prospecton serving vehicle assembly plants

p: Diesel generators run during outages add Scope 1. Keep fuel invoices for every month.
South Africa taxes direct emissions above thresholds. Note whether you pay it, since it may matter for steel and aluminium parts under CBAM.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
